Yet, 0 Great One, tell me, how will thy two sons, brought up

How will the young and tender Sita, worthy of happiness,

brief.summary_1line: Queen Kaushalya, grieving Rama’s exile, reproaches King Dasharatha and questions how Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita will endure the forest and whether Rama would accept a tainted kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaushalya weeps before King Dasharatha in the palace, raising her hands in anguish as she laments Rama’s exile.
In Kaushalya’s imagined vision, Rama and Lakshmana lie on the forest floor using their arms as pillows while Sita sits beside them under dark trees.
Kaushalya, tearful and distraught, looks toward the distant forest as if searching for Rama’s lotus-like face.
